entities.name: Selhoff
entities.description: Fog-shrouded port town in Nephalia on Innistrad, haunted by the Nebelgast.

entities.name: Nebelgast
entities.description: Geist-filled spirit-mist surrounding much of Innistrad, thickest at Selhoff.

entities.name: Hadaken
entities.description: Necro-alchemist who animates skaabs and grants them flight.

entities.name: Dierk
entities.description: Necro-alchemist torn apart by eldrazi-infected werewolves at Vess Manor.

entities.name: Kraum
entities.description: Monstrous creature flying above Selhoff's rooftops.

entities.name: Minaldra
entities.description: Most famous Vizag, whose oracles grow ominous.

entities.name: Odila
entities.description: Witch said to dwell in the swamp.

entities.name: Ospid River
entities.description: River forming the delta where Selhoff stands.

entities.name: Bay of Vustrow
entities.description: Bay into which the Ospid empties.

entities.name: Sarka Manor
entities.description: Estate home to the Ospid Horror.
